title: AMC 8 Practice: Distance, Speed and Meeting Twice — How Far Apart?
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on two walkers who meet, turn around and meet again, solved by counting road lengths and by following one walker. (Level 5 of 5)
Ann and Bo walk toward each other, meet, walk on, turn around and meet again. How far apart are the towns? Vantee shows why the number three unlocks it: count the road lengths they walk together, then check it by following Bo, test every choice, and try a variant yourself.
